notes.title: Japanese Translation is here!
notes.content: Hello everyone, the Japanese translation for CBT with Yuuka Kazami is out now! If you have your default on steam set to Japanese, it should automatically be set to that, if not you can change the language via right clicking the game, clicking properties and selecting Japanese on the language tab of the game!

notes.title: Music added!
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I listened to some of your feedback and I think I added some nice, fitting music to the game, lemme know what you think. 

Among other things, I've added a custom game icon, created a credits section for the assets used, fixed some minor punctuation errors and added mine and the artist for the game's tagline! 

Take care and have a wonderful day!
